description: California and New York residential lease check: security deposit cap of 1 month's rent (CA Civ. Code §1950.5 as amended by AB 12, small-landlord exception; NY GOL §7-108), return deadline (CA 21 days, NY 14 days), landlord notice for non-renewal or rent increase (CA 30/60/90 days, NY RPL §226-c 30/60/90 days), the CA AB 1482 rent cap for Aug 2026 - Jul 2027 by region (8.1-8.8%) and NYC rent-stabilized renewals. AB 1482 sunset and NY Good Cause CPI after May 2026 are not computed. California and New York (CA OAG, courts self-help, nysenate.gov, NYC RGB), as of 2026-11-21. General information and estimates only: no legal advice, no representation, no filing; values that could not be verified are flagged in the result, not computed.
